$comment: Container images used by the build, Compose and CI (ADR-0011/0012/0005). Every reference must be pinned BY DIGEST: `node deploy/scripts/pin-images.mjs --resolve` (needs registry access; run by the orchestrator or IT) fills `digest`, `--apply` rewrites every file in `usedIn`, and `--check` (offline) fails while any digest is missing or any file disagrees with this lock. A null digest means NOT YET PINNED; it is never a pass. Tags and support windows are [UNVERIFIED] until the resolve step records `verifiedAt`.
